description_en: Queries a list of LLM templates
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center list-llm-templates --model-template-id mt-xxxx --provider-template-id mpt-xxxx --llm-template-ids llmt-xxxx --llm-code qwen3.6-plus --smart-model false --biz-type 1 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --biz-language en-US --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLlmTemplates

parameters.help_zh: 所属模型服务商模板 ID
parameters.name: provider_template_id

parameters.help_en: The model template IDs for filtering
parameters.help_zh: 模型模板 ID 筛选
parameters.name: llm_template_ids

parameters.help_en: The model code for filtering. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 模型编码筛选，支持模糊查询
parameters.name: llm_code

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query smart models. Valid values:
true: Only LLMs under system-preset smart models are returned. In this case, BizType is required.
false: Smart models are not specifically filtered.
Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否查智能模型：true-只返回系统预置智能模型下的LLM（此时BizType必传），不传默认false
parameters.name: smart_model

parameters.help_en: The business type. This parameter is required when SmartModel is set to true
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. A value of 0 returns the same result as 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从1开始，0和1返回相同结果
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The display language of the model. Valid values:
zh-CN: Simplified Chinese.
en-US: English.
ja-JP: Japanese.
zh-TW: Traditional Chinese.
Default value: zh-CN. Currently, zh-TW returns Simplified Chinese, and ja-JP returns English. If the model is not included in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio or the English text is missing, the original source text is retained without automatic translation
parameters.help_zh: 模型展示语言。取值：zh-CN（简体中文）、en-US（英文）、ja-JP（日语）、zh-TW（繁体中文）。未传默认 zh-CN；当前 zh-TW 返回简体中文，ja-JP 返回英文。百炼未收录或英文文案缺失时保留原来源文案，不自动翻译
parameters.name: language
